steps.data:
<?php
add_action('after_setup_theme', function() {
	$u = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WordPress/blueprints/refs/heads/trunk/blueprints/welcome/assets/imgs/playground-logo.png';
	$i = get_option('github_imported_logo_id');
	if (!$i || !wp_get_attachment_url($i)) {
		require_once(ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/media.php');
		require_once(ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/file.php');
		require_once(ABSPATH . 'wp-admin/includes/image.php');
		$r = wp_remote_get($u);
		if (!is_wp_error($r) && wp_remote_retrieve_response_code($r) === 200) {
			$d = wp_upload_dir();
			$f = $d['path'] . '/playground-logo.png';
			file_put_contents($f, wp_remote_retrieve_body($r));
			$i = media_handle_sideload(['name' => 'playground-logo.png', 'tmp_name' => $f], 0);
			if (file_exists($f)) unlink($f);
			if (!is_wp_error($i)) update_option('github_imported_logo_id', $i);
		}
	}
	if ($i) {
		if (!has_custom_logo()) set_theme_mod('custom_logo', $i);
		if (!has_site_icon()) update_option('site_icon', $i);
	}
});

add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', function() {
	wp_enqueue_script(
		'target-blank-links',
		content_url('mu-plugins/target-blank-links.js'),
		[],
		null,
		true
	);
});
